works.body:
Hello Mitsuba, I love your art! The bright colors & lively expressions you create touches my heart. My favorite anime as a child was Tokyo mew mew & your art reminds me so much of that beautiful show! It would be an honor to have a custom art piece from you.

Please draw my vampire catgirl. Her looks & personality are both morbid & cute. Here are the references: https://nyafangs.nekoweb.org/references.html The link includes things about her personality, details, height, age, etc! Please try to include all her design details if possible! Draw her however you want, surprise me! The only thing I request is that the artwork is suited for an asmr thumbnail. Thank you.

Here are my preferences that are optional but very appreciated!
1. I prefer 16:9 canvas. A canvas that would look good on Twitch streams or for videos.
2. I appreciate if all possible file types can be included in the delivery. PSD file is very appreciated. 
3. I commission artists for help with asmr thumbnails & it's very appreciated when you consider creating an artwork that shows my character being an asmrtist. If you need pose references & inspiration for this idea please go to this link where I have compiled some inspirational photos: https://nyafangs.nekoweb.org/inspo.html

Note: Usage will be for social media like Twitch. Of course, with crediting you as the artist!

こんにちは!!!あなたのアートスタイルが本当に素敵なので、私のキャラクターもあなたのスタイルにしたいです。(2番目/ピンクのキャラクターは男の子です。)
https://toyhou.se/7745126.cygnus
https://toyhou.se/8868163.orion

うさぎの女の子は月の女神で、恥ずかしがり屋だけどエレガントです。魚の男の子は海の王子で、とても明るく優しい。二人は織姫と彦星のような恋人で、年に一度しか会うことができません。年に一度しか会えない、織姫と彦星のような恋人同士。
しかも、二人ともバレエの才能があるのです。

できれば、バレエをテーマにしたロマンチックなイラストをお願いしたいです。衣装は、あなたが可愛いと思うものを自由に描いて下さいね。

ありがとうございました。
